title: Legacy Cradle Data Parsing Settings
description: Regular expressions that Device Management uses to parse legacy encoded cradle data (signals.cradleData) into a wall map ID, row and column. Structured cradle reports (signals.cradle) do not use these settings.

enableCradleAutomapping.title: Enable Automatic Cradle Mapping (Deprecated)
enableCradleAutomapping.description: Deprecated. Device Management ignores this flag and always discovers walls and cradle positions from scanner reports. Kept only so that existing stored values remain valid; do not set it in new configurations.

cradleDataRowRegex.title: Cradle Data Row Pattern (Regex)
cradleDataRowRegex.description: Regular expression to extract the row number from legacy cradleData. Applies only to legacy cradleData; structured cradle reports do not use it. Example: '(?<=;).*?(?=;)' extracts '1' from '100;1;2'.

cradleDataColRegex.title: Cradle Data Column Pattern (Regex)
cradleDataColRegex.description: Regular expression to extract the column number from legacy cradleData. Applies only to legacy cradleData; structured cradle reports do not use it. Example: '[^;]+$' extracts '2' from '100;1;2'.

cradleDataWallMapIdRegex.title: Cradle Data Wall MapId Pattern (Regex)
cradleDataWallMapIdRegex.description: Regular expression to extract the wall map ID from legacy cradleData. Applies only to legacy cradleData; structured cradle reports do not use it. Example: '^.*?(?=;)' extracts '100' from '100;1;2'.
